script_line: I like flowers and stuff, but this place no give flavor. No gold, where's the signs, the bling-blings, come on!
transcript: I like flowers and stuff, but this place no gift flavor. No gold, who's the size, the bling blings, come on!
spanish_line: Me gustan las flores y esas cosas, pero este lugar no da sabor. No hay oro, ¿dónde están las señales, los bling-blings, vamos!

script_line: Damn, Jett, have you ever considered a life of crime? I have contacts. Let me know.
transcript: Damn Jett, have you ever considered a life of crime? I have contacts. Let me know.
spanish_line: Maldición, Jett, ¿alguna vez has considerado una vida de crimen? Tengo contactos. Avísame.

script_line: Never been in a knife fight, have you?
transcript: Never been in a knife fight, have you?
spanish_line: Nunca has estado en una pelea de cuchillos, ¿verdad?

script_line: Hell yeah! Who's up for another?
transcript: Hell yeah! Who's that poor another?

script_line: Phoenix, if you keep pulling stunts like that, you can brag as much as you like.
transcript: Phoenix, if you keep pulling stunts like that, you can brag as much as you like.
spanish_line: Phoenix, si sigues haciendo acrobacias como esa, puedes presumir tanto como quieras.

script_line: You've earned this win, let's make it official!
transcript: You've earned this win! Let's make it official!
spanish_line: ¡Te has ganado esta victoria, hagámoslo oficial!

script_line: I would hate working here. You couldn't pay me to sit at a desk.
transcript: I would hate working here. You couldn't pay me to sit at a desk.
spanish_line: Odiaría trabajar aquí. No podías pagarme para que me sentara en un escritorio.

script_line: How did they think this would end?
transcript: How did they think this would end?

script_line: I feel bad for them, I really do. Just not enough to stop winning.
transcript: I feel bad for them, I really do. Just not enough to stop winning!
spanish_line: Me siento mal por ellos, de verdad. Pero no lo suficiente para dejar de ganar.

script_line: Oh, oh dear no sweetheart! We must protect you.
transcript: Oh, oh dear, no, sweetheart! We must protect you!
spanish_line: ¡Oh, oh querido, no cariño! Debemos protegerte.

script_line: Nothing stays hidden from me. Nothing.
transcript: Nothing stays hidden from me. Nothing.

script_line: Fade, now you're just showing off.
transcript: Fade, now you're just showing off.

script_line: The greatest battles ever fought are written in storybooks. May they write about this one.
transcript: The greatest battles ever fought are written in storybooks. Made they write about this one.
spanish_line: Las batallas más grandes jamás peleadas están escritas en libros de cuentos. Que escriban sobre esto.

script_line: When we are at peace, I would meet you again.
transcript: When we are at peace, I would meet you again.
spanish_line: Cuando estemos en paz, nos volveremos a encontrar.

script_line: Hey, who has a good song for 'we were losing but now things are looking up'? You know, like uh, redemption arc.
transcript: Hey, who has a good song for, we were losing but now things are looking up, you know, like a redemption arc?
spanish_line: Oye, ¿quién tiene una buena canción para "estamos perdiendo pero ahora las cosas están mejorando"? Ya sabes, como el arco de redención.

script_line: It is strange, Sage. Where I'm from, you're no medic, only a weapon.
transcript: It is strange, Sage. Where I'm from, you're no medic, only a weapon.
spanish_line: Es extraño, Sage. De donde yo soy, no eres médico, sólo un arma.

script_line: Is Killjoy here? I could use some repairs.
transcript: Is Killjoy here? I could use some repairs.
spanish_line: ¿Está Killjoy aquí? Me vendrían bien algunas reparaciones.

script_line: Everyone makes fun of German efficiency, haha. Just keep laughing as you use all my gear.
transcript: Everyone makes fun of German efficiency! Haha! Just keep laughing as you use all my gear.
spanish_line: Todo el mundo se burla de la eficiencia alemana, jaja. Sigue riendo mientras usas todo mi equipo.
Nuestro portador de picos está muerto.

script_line: I can buy, who needs what?
transcript: I can buy. Who needs what?

script_line: You think you can kill me?
transcript: You think you can kill me?

script_line: Next time I'm gettin' first place!
transcript: Next time I'm getting first place.
spanish_line: ¡La próxima vez tendré el primer lugar!

script_line: Cypher, I'm so sorry about breaking all your stuff. I mean, I won't stop, but I am sorry.
transcript: Cypher, I'm so sorry about breaking all your stuff. I mean, I won't stop, but I am sorry.
spanish_line: Cypher, siento mucho haber roto todas tus cosas. Quiero decir, no voy a parar, pero lo siento.

script_line: Spend those creds before we lose them.
transcript: Spend those cries before we lose them.
spanish_line: Gasta esas credenciales antes de que las perdamos.

script_line: Focus your hate at the enemy, KAY/O, it is wasted on me.
transcript: Focus your hate at the enemy, KAYO. It is wasted on me.
spanish_line: Concéntrate en tu odio hacia el enemigo, KAY/O, está desperdiciado en mí.

script_line: If you've never seen a massacre, this is what it looks like.
transcript: If you've never seen a massacre, this is what it looks like.
spanish_line: Si nunca has visto una masacre, esto es lo que parece.

script_line: I've stood over so many corpses. A few more, does not matter.
transcript: Have stood over so many corpses. A few more does not matter.
spanish_line: Me he parado sobre tantos cadáveres. Unos pocos más, no importa.

script_line: This poor place. It clings to life. A city after my own heart
transcript: Ah, this poor place, it brings to life. A city after my own heart.
spanish_line: Este pobre lugar. Se aferra a la vida. Una ciudad después de mi propio corazón

script_line: This city is safe once more.
transcript: This city is safe once more.
spanish_line: Esta ciudad está a salvo una vez más.

script_line: Strong finish. Could be even stronger.
transcript: Strong finish. Could be even stronger.
spanish_line: Acabado fuerte. Podría ser aún más fuerte.

script_line: Level heads until we're home, yes? Good.
transcript: Level heads until we're home, yes? Good.
spanish_line: Cabezas de nivel hasta que estemos en casa, ¿sí? Bien.
No vale la pena las balas.

script_line: If any of you mattered, you'd be alive.
transcript: If any of you mattered, you'd be alive.
spanish_line: Si alguno de ustedes importara, estaría vivo.

script_line: So, you use explosives to propel yourself, Raze. That's... that's creative. I think I like it.
transcript: So, you use explosives to propel yourself, Raze. That's- that's creative. I think I like it.
spanish_line: Así que usas explosivos para propulsarte, Raze. Eso es... Eso es creativo. Creo que me gusta.

script_line: That's me over there! Great, now I can kick my own ass.
transcript: That's me over there. Great. Now I can kick my own ass.
spanish_line: ¡Ese de ahí soy yo! Genial, ahora puedo patear mi propio trasero.

script_line: Spend your money now. There's no bank in hell.
transcript: Spend your money now. There's no bank in hell.
spanish_line: Gasta tu dinero ahora. No hay banco en el infierno.
